fields.DESCRIPTION: Brighten your everyday with the Meadow Weave Handcrafted Bag. Featuring delicate multicolour floral motifs on natural jute fabric, paired with earthy woven textures and fringed detailing, this bag radiates rustic charm. The sturdy leather strap with golden accents ensures both durability and style, while the spacious interior makes it perfect for work, study, or travel. A harmonious blend of traditional artistry and modern functionality, designed for the free-spirited professional.
